payout_quote: Official meowtel.com: 'Be your own boss, set your own rates & availability, and meet ameowzing kitties near you!' And: 'Sitter rates start at $20 for 20 minutes of in-home cat sitting.' Meowtel help FAQ (Customer Payments): 'Sitters keep 100% of all tips received through Meowtel.'
steps: Apply on meowtel.com as a cat sitter (application, screening quiz, references, background check, onboarding call).
Build your sitter profile with photo, bio, services, and availability.
Set your own rates and service radius.
Accept reservations and complete drop-in visits or overnight stays; get paid through Meowtel.
catches: Rates are self-set and vary by region; bookings are not guaranteed — income depends on demand and completed visits.
Selective screening (background check, quiz, references, onboarding call); not all applicants are accepted.
A 10% Trust & Safety fee (rounded up to nearest $0.25 per visit) is charged on the customer side; sitters set their own rates.
Cats-only platform; market is narrower than full-service pet platforms.
biggest_catch: Selective approval plus variable demand: you set your own rates (starting at $20/20-min per Meowtel) but bookings are never guaranteed, and only approved sitters in Meowtel service areas can earn.
eligibility: Cat sitters in Meowtel service areas who pass the application, screening quiz, reference/background checks, and onboarding.
timing: Application review takes days; paid per completed reservation through Meowtel.
